articles.headline: Died -- Abraham Shinglaton Gray
articles.summary: Died, after a protracted illness which lasted six years, October 26th, 1867, in the 36th year of his age, Abraham Shinglaton Gray. He was born near Allentown, N.J., A.D. 1831. Seven years prior to his death he became serious and joined the Presbyterian church. He was very useful; he taught the day school and assisted in the Sabbath-school in the A.M.E. Church. He leaves an aged mother and two brothers and one sister to mourn his loss. (Followed by an elegiac verse.)
